description.EN: A visiting housekeeper cleans the rooms and helps you with the larger chores. The spare bedrooms remain yours.
description.CN: 定时上门整理房间，也能帮你处理费时的家务。客房仍留给你和同住者。

description.EN: The cook lays the table and warms dishes from your pantry. Shared meals use the food you have brought home.
description.CN: 摆好餐具，帮你热好储存的菜肴。一起吃饭仍需使用你带回家的食物。

description.EN: The steward checks invitation lists, receives guests and helps keep a private dinner running smoothly.
description.CN: 核对邀请名单、接待来客，让私人宴会的安排更从容。

description.EN: The guard checks visitors at the entrance from eight in the evening until eight in the morning. Your first rest with a paid guard on duty reduces stress by 1 more, once per day.
description.CN: 从晚八点到早八点在入口值守，核对访客身份。门卫已领薪并当值时，首次坐下休息额外减少1点压力，每天一次。
